## Acceptance reconciliation

Completed the source-only assessment for the full 31-component family and all three exact county contacts. The retained packet at `research/geography/usa31-gap-family-source-fitness-20261007/` preserves and joins all 31 candidate and physical/query rows, 37 referenced GSHHG records, all 15 numeric closure rows against the complete #1300 scope, and exact contact records from the 2018/2025 TIGER/Line archives, 2018 geoBoundaries products, and 2026 TIGERweb capture.

The independent exact-head review accepted PR #1384 at `3463ccd2756be61a2d9750d1d2514d58303e5438`; the normal merge queue merged it as `281424146684b98e754efba910178c7b42f3850a`. I verified the merged commit contains the same 48 paths, modes, and Git blob bodies as the reviewed head.

All 31 dispositions remain source-history-unresolved. The differences between geoBoundaries and TIGER/Line remain unexplained, and the retained GSHHG records do not establish legal boundaries, ownership, or land/water classification. These limits are explicit in the packet; no geometry, hierarchy, ownership, production, or release change was made. There is no additional implementation work proposed under this child issue.
